sourceText:
Easy Tortilla Pizza
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Friday, June 3, 2011 - 6:50am

Ingredients




2 medium tortillas
2 large tomatoes, seeded and chopped
2 tablespoons onion, minced
1 clove garlic
1/2 tablespoon olive oil
1/4 cup water
1/2 cup white beans, rinsed and drained
1/2 cup low fat mozzarella cheese, shredded
1 cup basil, leaves

Preparation

1 In a large saucepan over medium heat, add oil. Then add onion and garlic and cook for 4 – 5 minutes to soften. Then add tomatoes and 1/4 cup water. Cook for 15 – 20 minutes until tomatoes are cooked down. 2 Preheat oven to 350. 3 In a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat toast the tortillas on both sides, and then move to a large cookie sheet. 4 Top each tortilla with tomato sauce, basil leaves, white beans and cheese. Bake for 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

About


This simple pizza recipe is perfect for a pizza craving, and low in calories.
